sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. sources.snippet: We are making the weights of Qwen3 available to the public, including both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models. The highlights from Qwen3 include: Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models of various sizes, available in 0.6B, 1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, 32B and 30B-A3B, 235B-A22B.
